客户端插件重复注册导致 web boot 中止：一个插件的重复 factory 注册会连坐后续所有插件不加载（如 dshmarket 消失）
应用内更新到 0.11.0 静默失败且无任何提示（per-machine 安装未获提权）
[bug]同时开了十多个项目，Mac进入锁屏后一段时间后，必定崩溃。
[Bug] 设置→插件市场「安装插件市场」按钮静默失败：dsh-desktop:// 自定义协议源的 mutation POST 过不了 Origin 信任链，请求从未到达后台（0.13.1）
[改进] 更新失败时错误文案误导 + 更新器缺少日志
[Windows] 自动升级连续三个版本（0.11.1 / 0.12.0 / 0.12.1）静默失败：安装器启动约 26 秒、安装目录 0 字节写入、无任何日志

latest_release.name: DSH Desktop v0.13.2
latest_release.body:
[中文](#cn-0.13.2) | [English](#en-0.13.2) 本版本重点提升 Safe Mode 和启动稳定性，并改进故障报告、安装器及 Windows 环境下的兼容性。

新增功能

- **故障报告**：将待处理报告汇总为每次启动最多一个确认弹窗；用户同意后最多发送 5 份报告，避免重复打扰。 ### 体验优化 - **故障诊断**：相同诊断错误在 10 分钟内去重，减少重复捕获与报告。 - **Office 集成**：Office 运行时资源缺失或配置无效时，发出警告并停用 Office 功能，不再阻断 Harness 启动。 - **安装器**：恢复安装完成后自动启动应用，同时避免强制提升安装器权限。 ### 问题修复 - **Safe Mode 与会话启动**：确保 Safe Mode 配置包含可用的默认模型；缺少模型选择时回退到 DeepSeek 官方默认模型，避免会话控制器卡住。 - **凭据与会话持久化**：遇到无效或旧版凭据键时跳过并警告；损坏的会话日志不再导致异常退出，并可隔离后继续列出其他会话。 - **锁文件恢复**：自动清理超过 10 秒的陈旧凭据和 Profile 写入锁，避免异常退出后下次启动等待超时。 - **Windows 沙箱与显卡回退**：为安装目录授予 Chromium AppContainer 所需的读取权限；显卡回退时放宽 GPU 沙箱限制，同时保留 Renderer 沙箱，改善受限权限或驱动环境下的启动兼容性。 ### 其他变更 - **Harness 兼容性**：更新会话控制器、凭据和会话持久化补丁，并补充对应回归测试，覆盖 Safe Mode、损坏数据容错、锁恢复和故障报告汇总。 --- This release improves Safe Mode and startup stability, and strengthens diagnostics, installer behavior, and compatibility on Windows.

Features

- **Error Reporting**: Consolidate pending reports into at most one confirmation dialog per launch; user consent allows up to five reports to be sent, reducing repeated prompts. ### Improvements - **Diagnostics**: Deduplicate identical diagnostic errors for 10 minutes to reduce repeated captures and reports. - **Office Integration**: Warn and disable Office features when runtime resources are missing or configuration is invalid, rather than blocking Harness startup. - **Installer**: Restore automatic app launch after installation without forcing the installer to elevate privileges. ### Bug Fixes - **Safe Mode & Session Startup**: Ensure Safe Mode includes a usable default model and fall back to DeepSeek’s official default when model selection is unavailable, preventing the session controller from hanging. - **Credentials & Session Persistence**: Skip and warn about invalid or legacy credential keys; corrupted session logs no longer cause failures and can be isolated so other sessions remain available. - **Stale Lock Recovery**: Automatically remove credential and profile writer locks older than 10 seconds, preventing launch timeouts after an abnormal exit. - **Windows Sandbox & GPU Fallback**: Grant Chromium AppContainer the required read access to the install directory. GPU fallback relaxes the GPU sandbox while preserving the Renderer sandbox, improving startup compatibility in restricted-permission or driver environments. ### Chores - **Harness Compatibility**: Update the session-controller, credentials, and session-persistence patches, with regression coverage for Safe Mode, corrupted data, stale-lock recovery, and aggregated error reporting.
